title: Experts disagree on HUD stage strip animations
context:
Chief architect: Ruled by the chief, no question needed: the two claims do not compete. Keep the same markup and change only colour or class so animations never restart (EX-qa-engineer-12 makes that the testable part), and also honour reduced motion so state stays readable from colour plus word. Both ship; neither is a redesign.

Target: HUD stage strip animations
- ux-ui-analyst: a state change (running, paused, marked) changes colour or class on the same markup instead of replacing the node, so running animations do not restart; the Edit node spin completes full turns
- ux-ui-analyst: with reduced motion set by the person (prefers-reduced-motion), the strip pulses and spins stop and state is still readable from colour plus word (WCAG 2.2 2.3.3)
